description: My work (the reference screen of the Future page pattern, docs/redesign/BUILDING-FUTURE-SCREENS.md): v = store.view('work') with the Guide's next step (fxGuide.story), set by loadChain on vbEnter and again on every fxRefresh (the store changed). Clicks go through actChain (data-act) and openChain (data-nav, data-record).

v.description: store.view('work') (fxViews.work: me, items per screen, total, myRequests, unfinished, notifications, guide) plus story: fxGuide.story(guide, me.id).

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
